title: pool build makes no paid call unless asked: a fresh --out path asks a model for every eval regex
goal: benchmarks.py pool build to an --out path with no prior regexes prints the paid calls it would make and their dry-run estimate and makes none without an explicit flag, so a worker's local rebuild (ST-keicy7gn, one unplanned Sonnet call of about 0.06 USD) costs nothing by default
